row.evidence: Account Engagement has no SCIM endpoint of its own: "Salesforce User Sync makes it easy to create and manage Account Engagement users from Salesforce", and synced user records "are read-only and inherit information from Salesforce."
row.notes: Pardot is now sold as Marketing Cloud Account Engagement; editions are Growth+ $1,250, Plus+ $2,750, Advanced+ $4,400 and Premium+ $15,000 per org per month, billed annually (flat org pricing, so per-user fields are null). Users are not provisioned into Account Engagement directly: Salesforce User Sync creates, updates and recycle-bins Account Engagement users from users assigned in the connected Salesforce org (individually, by public group or by role), with Salesforce profiles mapped to Account Engagement roles. An IdP that provisions the Salesforce org over Salesforce's SCIM API (see the Salesforce row) therefore reaches Account Engagement indirectly; the merge may want to treat this as inherited from Salesforce. Sign-in is through Salesforce ("Log In with Salesforce"), so SSO follows the Salesforce org. The Account Engagement API v5 User object is read/query (plus tags) only, on every edition. The Okta OIN 'Pardot' app is a password-vaulting (SWA) app last updated 2014.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented for Account Engagement; user lifecycle comes from the connected Salesforce org through Salesforce User Sync.

capabilities.notes: The v5 User object documents only Read, Query, Add Tag and Remove Tag; user creation, updates and removal happen in Salesforce via User Sync.

endpoints.purpose: Add a tag to a user
Remove a tag from a user

rate_limits.text: Daily request allocation by edition (Growth 25,000; Plus 50,000; Advanced and Premium 100,000) and up to five concurrent API requests.

limitations.text: API calls must authenticate as a Salesforce SSO-enabled user and pass the Business Unit ID header.
Synced user records are read-only in Account Engagement.

okta.notes: OIN 'Pardot' app shows only SWA ticked (read from page markup); last updated May 2014.

fallbacks.other_sync: Salesforce User Sync: users assigned to Account Engagement in the connected Salesforce org (individually, by public group or role) get Account Engagement user records; unassigning sends them to the recycle bin; changes sync in about 10 minutes.

open_questions: Whether Account Engagement exposes an audit-log API is not documented on the pages read.

The exact Salesforce editions required alongside each Account Engagement edition (and therefore whether Salesforce SCIM is usable without Salesforce's API add-on) are not stated on the Account Engagement pricing page.
Whether unassigning a user in Salesforce frees an Account Engagement licence or ends sessions immediately is not documented.
